【Unique Style & Sports Vision】This electric bike for adults features a unique and imaginative design, complete with a cool bike headlight for optimal safety during night rides. The saddle is delicate and soft, with a strengthened pole and hollowed-out bracket that create a thrilling sports adventure experience. You'll turn heads with this bike and be the envy of others. Join us and try out the latest fashion trends!
【2000W high-speed motor & removable 48V 25Ah battery】This electric bike is a perfect choice for daily commutes and mountain adventures. The battery can be charged within 6-8 hours, and the bike can reach a top idling speed of 28+++mph/hour, providing a thrilling ride experience. Upgrade to our electric motorcycle for adults now and enjoy the convenience and excitement of this amazing ride!
【Fat Tires & Dual Hydraulic Disc Brakes】With its puncture-resistant 20"x4" fat tires, this ebike provides a stable grip on any terrain, including snow, beaches, and rough mountain roads. The dual oil disc brakes offer greater stopping power and precise, instant braking, even in wet weather, ensuring your safety at all times.
【Shamano 7-Speed & F/R Shock Absorber】Our electric dirt bike for adults features a high-strength front suspension and rear suspension fork that effectively absorbs shocks and provides better control while riding. The Shamano 7-gear shifting allows for reliable precision and comfortable ride control.
【3 Riding Modes & Long Distance】This electric mountain bike offers three riding modes: pure electric, electric assist, and pedal. It can travel up to 80km-120km/50-75 miles in pure electric mode, depending on rider weight and road conditions, making it perfect for long-distance travel.
【Features & Accessories 】Complete with a 7.2" phone holder (18.5x8.5cm/7.3x3.4inch) and a spacious storage box (22x14x11cm/8.6x5.5x4.3 inch). The bike also features a multi-function LCD Display, high brightness front light, and tail light for added safety. And with 90% pre-assembly, you can easily install it.
